open_points.subject: A3
open_points.text:
After condition 5 a stored image may remain without a record: no caller has received
   its reference, and a repeated delivery of the same file writes it again and completes the placement,
   unless a refusal of A6 rule 5 applies.

- INV-06: a second placement returns the first publication and leaves every stored image and placement record unchanged, with one placement record in place (`test_a_repeated_placement_writes_no_durable_state`). A delivery repeated after a failed record write completes the placement (`test_a_delivery_repeated_after_a_failed_record_write_completes`).
open_points.question: Must the INV-06 recovery test show completion only when no A6 rule 5 refusal applies, or must a retry after the failed record write complete even when such a refusal condition is present?
options: Qualify the required test: with no A6 rule 5 refusal condition, the retry completes; with one, it returns M08 STATE_UNAVAILABLE and changes nothing.
Treat the required-test sentence as unconditional: every retry after a failed record write completes, overriding A6 rule 5 for that retry.
open_points.default_guess: Qualify the recovery test and preserve A6 rule 5: completion is required only when no applicable refusal condition exists.

witness.initial: A valid delivery has written its stored image, its placement-record write failed, and no placement exists.
events: A storage fault or operator leaves a damaged mark record for the same project and source, a state explicitly covered by A6 and its INV-20 test.
The caller repeats delivery of the same source file.
outcomes: The amended A3 rule together with A6 rule 5 returns M08 with STATE_UNAVAILABLE, writes nothing, and does not complete the placement.
The unqualified INV-06 Required tests sentence requires the repeated delivery to complete the placement.
witness.observer: The caller sees refusal versus completion, and an inspector of durable state sees no placement versus a completed placement.
